valid_rules.name: Emails with subject mentioning meetings should go to Calendar folder
valid_rules.conditions: subject_contains "meeting" OR subject_contains "mtg" OR subject_contains "invite" OR subject_contains "calendar"

valid_rules.name: Emails about California updates should go to California folder
Emails from Gail Brownfeld or about Sempra, depositions, or synfuel should go to Deleted Items > Sempra folder
valid_rules.conditions: from_contains "gail.brownfeld@enron.com" OR subject_contains "sempra" OR content_contains "sempra" OR subject_contains "depo" OR subject_contains "deposition" OR subject_contains "synfuel"

valid_rules.name: Emails from Brendan Fitzsimmons or about Hill stimulus bill should go to Americas > Regulatory folder
valid_rules.conditions: from_contains "brendan.fitzsimmons@enron.com" OR subject_contains "hill stimulus bill update" OR content_contains "stimulus bill"

valid_rules.name: Emails mentioning anthrax or OOC/MRHA should go to Americas > MRHA > OOC folder
valid_rules.conditions: subject_contains "anthrax" OR content_contains "anthrax" OR subject_contains "ooc" OR content_contains "out of compliance" OR subject_contains "mrha"

valid_rules.name: Emails about EnronOnline or IT systems should go to Americas > IT folder
valid_rules.conditions: subject_contains "enrononline" OR content_contains "enrononline" OR subject_contains "password" OR subject_contains "server" OR subject_contains "vpn" OR subject_contains "email outage"

valid_rules.name: Emails about budgeting, forecasts, or business plans should go to Americas > Business Plans folder
valid_rules.conditions: (subject_contains "budget" AND content_contains "allocations") OR subject_contains "budget allocations" OR subject_contains "business plan" OR subject_contains "forecast" OR subject_contains "strategy"

valid_rules.name: Emails about EGM or mid-market customer transitions should go to Americas > Gas folder
Emails about SOX financing, payment/prepayment requests, MTBE/Equiva should go to Americas > ESVL folder
valid_rules.conditions: subject_contains "prepayment request" OR subject_contains "payment request" OR subject_contains "sox" OR content_contains "so2" OR content_contains "mtbe" OR content_contains "equiva" OR from_contains "louisdreyfus.com" OR from_contains "h..harrison@enron.com" OR from_contains "s..bradford@enron.com" OR from_contains "c..lewis@enron.com"

valid_rules.name: Emails from galleries or about artists should go to Art Comm folder
valid_rules.conditions: (from_contains "gallery" OR from_contains "galerie" OR from_contains "glry" OR from_contains "mfah.org") OR subject_contains "burtynsky" OR subject_contains "lewandowski" OR subject_contains "paley" OR subject_contains "schulz" OR (subject_contains "invoice" AND from_contains "galerie")

valid_rules.name: Emails about trading simulations or London contacts should go to Global Mkts folder
valid_rules.conditions: subject_contains "trading simulation" OR subject_contains "london contact" OR from_contains "sophie.kingsley@enron.com" OR content_contains "trader"

valid_rules.name: Personal emails from common personal domains or with casual subjects should go to Personal folder
valid_rules.conditions: from_contains "@aol.com" OR from_contains "@rocketmail.com" OR from_contains "@abc.com" OR from_contains "sheckys.com" OR from_contains "unterberg.com" OR from_contains "capitalz.com" OR subject_contains "thank you" OR subject_contains "it's me" OR subject_contains "menina"
